summary: At step 295, do.c goto_level calls trap.c fill_pit on the departing square. C extracts the floor boulder and calls do.c flooreffects("settle"), which consumes delobj’s rn2(100) and prints the boulder message; js/trap.js extracts it and records note_unported("do.c flooreffects"), so JavaScript reaches rn2(3) instead. The Stronghold caller also exposes a separate dungeon.c goto_hell gap, but implementing that helper does not change this replay’s first mismatch.

source.branch: When the departing hero square contains a boulder over a pit or hole, fill_pit extracts the boulder and passes it to do.c flooreffects with verb "settle".
callers: do.c goto_level() after a falling transition
do.c dodown() may select goto_hell(FALSE, TRUE) for a Stronghold hole
dependencies: do.c flooreffects() existing JS boulder/pit branch in js/do.js
dungeon.c goto_hell() is a separate caller gap and does not cause the first mismatch in this case

evidence: Accepted v64 source evaluation shows the first mismatch at step 295: C follows do.c goto_level to trap.c fill_pit, where a floor boulder over a hole is extracted and passed to do.c flooreffects("settle"); JavaScript skips that call and diverges in RNG and screen output.

The JS change awaits the existing flooreffects call after boulder removal and propagates completion through production fill_pit callers, including mon.c mon_leaving_level and dog migration callers. Focused checks cover the migration boulder path; accepted v42 and v43 full replay ranges cover ordinary pet transfer and steed arrival caller paths.

correction.cause: Making fill_pit async unconditionally made mon_leaving_level, m_detach, and mongone asynchronous even when the source fill_pit branch had no boulder to settle. That broke synchronous callers and tests. Separate production migration callers also continued before dog.c migrate_to_level finished.
changes: fill_pit returns synchronously when the C pit-or-hole-and-boulder condition is false, and returns flooreffects' promise after extracting a matching boulder.
mon_leaving_level keeps C's synchronous no-op teardown and awaits floor effects only when fill_pit returns a promise.
clearpriests, mlevel_tele_trap, and wiz_migrate_mons now wait for promise-returning monster removal or migration before continuing. really_done awaits clearpriests.
The existing mongone/m_detach synchronous assertions remain intact; the planning-boundary test now expects the source-synchronous throw on the no-settle path.
checks: Focused hosted-failure test selection: 361/361 passed across paybill-end-cleanup, sp-lev-object, themeroom-fill, makemon-create, teleport-monster-traps, mktrap-orchestration, wizard-migration, and mon-kill tests.
recordings/wizcmds.c/migration-negative-limit.session.json matched its JavaScript replay: 2927/2927 RNG calls, 55/55 screens, and 55/55 cursors.
